terms: Free to use with attribution. Derived values only: no day-ahead or imbalance prices are republished here or anywhere else in this dataset.
unit: EUR per MW of trading capacity, summed over the delivery day
granularity: one row per zone per delivery day, newest pass only

benchmarks.passive_da_buy_value: Buy 1 MW on the day-ahead auction for every PTU of the day and settle the position in imbalance. No foresight: the same side every PTU.
benchmarks.passive_da_sell_value: Sell 1 MW on the day-ahead auction for every PTU of the day and settle the position in imbalance. No foresight: the same side every PTU.
benchmarks.extractable_value: The better of the two passive positions, chosen per PTU with perfect hindsight. It can be negative where dual imbalance pricing leaves the day-ahead price inside the penalty band, and that negative is real.
benchmarks.adverse_value: The worse of the two passive positions, chosen per PTU with perfect hindsight. Where a zone prices imbalance single-sided it is the exact mirror of extractable_value.
benchmarks.trailing_bias_value: The result of the hourly trailing-bias rule, which picks the day-ahead side from a trailing mean per hour of day and uses only what was known before the auction closed. Empty where no decision was issued.

columns.delivery_day: The delivery day in the zone's own market time, ISO date.
columns.ptu: How many 15-minute periods the day was graded on. Less than a full day means the source published fewer.
columns.ptu_with_action: How many of those carried a decision of ours. The denominator for trailing_bias_value.
columns.pass: as-known (graded the morning after delivery) or as-final (regraded after imbalance settled).
columns.calc_iteration: Which pass this is for this delivery day, counting from 1.
columns.knownby_ts: The instant the row was computed — everything in it was knowable then.
columns.source_file: The frozen published document this row was derived from.

forecast_columns.delivery_day: The day the decision is FOR, in the zone's own market time.
forecast_columns.knownby_ts: When the decision was made. Always before the day-ahead gate of the day before delivery_day.
forecast_columns.ptu: 15-minute periods in the delivery day (92, 96 or 100).
forecast_columns.ptu_buy: Periods with action +1: buy on the day-ahead auction, settle in imbalance.
forecast_columns.ptu_sell: Periods with action -1: sell on the day-ahead auction, settle in imbalance.
forecast_columns.ptu_no_action: Periods with no action. ptu = ptu_buy + ptu_sell + ptu_no_action, always.
forecast_columns.data_through: The freshest fact the signal saw.
forecast_columns.skip_reason: Empty: where there is no action, the signal did not form. Set: the forecast was REFUSED, and the value says why (kind:missing day[:leg]).
forecast_columns.source_file: The frozen published forecast this row was derived from; per-period actions are there.
